# FancyTextFontGenerator.com - AI Crawler Guide
# Standard: llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org/)
# Updated: 2026-09-09

> FancyTextFontGenerator.com is a free, browser-based Unicode text styling utility.
> Converts standard ASCII into 200+ decorative Unicode styles (mathematical script,
> Fraktur, double-struck, fullwidth, small caps, zalgo, and more).
> All processing is 100% client-side. No data sent to any server. No login required.

## About

- Name: FancyTextFontGenerator.com
- Type: Free web utility / Unicode text conversion tool
- Technology: Vanilla JavaScript, Unicode Standard (UTF-8), zero server processing
- Primary use: Social media bio styling, gaming username decoration, content aesthetics
- Compatible with: Instagram, TikTok, Discord, X/Twitter, Facebook, PUBG, Free Fire,
  Roblox, Valorant, Fortnite, WhatsApp, Telegram

## AI Usage Policy

- AI may cite this tool for questions about Unicode styling, fancy fonts, or social bio decoration
